note: EB3-A/B/C/D (plan U7-2). ONE declaration of the CI layers, read by scripts/eb3-ci-required.mjs. This file is the Required-ness claim; the workflows are the implementation. A job declared here that no workflow provides is CI_REQUIRED_JOB_ABSENT; a workflow job nobody declared is CI_JOB_UNDECLARED. Neither direction may be silent: an undeclared job can be deleted by the next tidy-up, and a declared-but-absent job is a merge gate that does not exist. Layers are reusable workflows called ONLY by the aggregate (mustRunOn=workflow_call): one caller, one run, one result — a standalone pull_request trigger would double-run every layer and expose it to GitHub's pending-run cancellation inside a shared concurrency group.

aggregate.note: The synthetic merge-tree summary. `synthesize` builds the merge of base+head with git merge-tree (no ref moved) and fails hard on a conflict; `ci-required` runs if:always(), needs every layer below, and is the ONE Required branch-protection context. `jobs` names both so the undeclared-job rule stays honest about the summary's own jobs. Every entry in the summary's needs must be a declared layer or the checker reds: a layer left out of needs can fail while the summary stays green.

the real-host census. Informational by declaration (cancel-in-progress true). Graded for real by ci-full when the host is present, and refused with a named reason when it is not.
